```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      max_turns:
        description: 'Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)'
        required: false
        default: '50'
        type: number

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout instantsearch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Get latest release
        id: get_release
        run: |
          # Get latest release tag
          LATEST_RELEASE=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "v0.0.0")
          echo "latest_release=$LATEST_RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
          # Get release date
          RELEASE_DATE=$(git log -1 --format=%ai $LATEST_RELEASE 2>/dev/null || echo "1970-01-01")
          echo "release_date=$RELEASE_DATE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
          # Get commit hash
          COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          echo "commit_hash=$COMMIT_HASH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Setup Claude Code
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
        run: |
          # Install Claude Code CLI
          npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
          echo "Claude Code installed"

      - name: Run Claude Code for Documentation
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          MAX_TURNS: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_turns || 50 }}
        run: |
          # Create temporary directory for Claude output
          mkdir -p /tmp/claude-output
          
          # Run Claude Code for each package with proper quoting to prevent injection
          echo "Running Claude Code for instantsearch.js"
          claude-code \
            --package-name="instantsearch.js" \
            --file-extension=".js.mdx" \
            --output-dir="/tmp/claude-output" \
            --max-turns="${MAX_TURNS}" \
            --timeout=600 \
            || echo "Claude processing failed for instantsearch.js"
          
          echo "Running Claude Code for react-instantsearch"
          claude-code \
            --package-name="react-instantsearch" \
            --file-extension=".react.mdx" \
            --output-dir="/tmp/claude-output" \
            --max-turns="${MAX_TURNS}" \
            --timeout=600 \
            || echo "Claude processing failed for react-instantsearch"
          
          echo "Running Claude Code for vue-instantsearch"
          claude-code \
            --package-name="vue-instantsearch" \
            --file-extension=".vue.mdx" \
            --output-dir="/tmp/claude-output" \
            --max-turns="${MAX_TURNS}" \
            --timeout=600 \
            || echo "Claude processing failed for vue-instantsearch"

      - name: Prepare documentation files
        id: prepare_docs
        run: |
          # Create a summary of what would be changed
          echo "Preparing documentation files..."
          
          # If running in dry-run mode, show what would happen
          if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.run_claude }}" == "false" ]]; then
            echo "DRY RUN MODE: Would process documentation but not actually run Claude"
            echo "Would process packages: instantsearch.js, react-instantsearch, vue-instantsearch"
            echo "Would generate files with extensions: .js.mdx, .react.mdx, .vue.mdx"
          fi
          
          # Create a simple summary file
          echo "Documentation Sync Summary" > /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "========================" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "- Latest Release: ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_release }}" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "- Release Date: ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.release_date }}" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "- Commit Hash: ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.commit_hash }}" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "Packages to process:" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "- instantsearch.js (.js.mdx)" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "- react-instantsearch (.react.mdx)" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md
          echo "- vue-instantsearch (.vue.mdx)" >> /tmp/docs-summary.md

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'true' && (github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' || github.event_name == 'schedule')
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          commit-message: "docs: update documentation for ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_release }}"
          title: "docs: update documentation for ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_release }}"
          body: |
            This PR was automatically generated by the docs automation workflow.
            
            ## Summary
            Updates documentation for the latest release: ${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_release }}
            
            ## Changes
            - Updated documentation for instantsearch.js
            - Updated documentation for react-instantsearch  
            - Updated documentation for vue-instantsearch
            
            ## Generated by
            Automated documentation sync workflow
            
            <!-- Auto-generated by docs-automation workflow -->
          branch: docs-sync-${{ steps.get_release.outputs.latest_release }}
          delete-branch: true
          draft: true
          reviewers: frontend-experiences-web

      - name: Show Dry Run Info
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'false' && github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "=== DRY RUN MODE ==="
          echo "This is a dry run. No actual changes were made."
          echo ""
          echo "What would happen:"
          echo "- Check for latest release"
          echo "- Process documentation for all packages"
          echo "- Generate MDX files with correct extensions"
          echo "- Show summary of changes"
          echo ""
          echo "To enable actual processing:"
          echo "1. Set 'run_claude' to true"
          echo "2. Set 'create_pr' to true for PR creation"
          echo ""
          echo "Current settings:"
          echo "- run_claude: ${{ github.event.inputs.run_claude }}"
          echo "- create_pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.create_pr }}"

      - name: Show Preview Info
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' && github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "=== PREVIEW MODE ==="
          echo "Claude has been run but no PR was created."
          echo ""
          echo "What happened:"
          echo "- Claude processed documentation for all packages"
          echo "- Files were generated in temporary directory"
          echo "- No changes were pushed to docs-new repository"
          echo ""
          echo "To create a PR:"
          echo "Set 'create_pr' to true in workflow dispatch"
```
